data_roles.fit: 129 official-train questions and 294 synthetic_common/t3 pairs; gradient updates only
data_roles.inner_validation: 32 official-train questions and 74 synthetic_common/t3 pairs; model selection only; exact S4 score averaging
data_roles.official_dev: 65 synthetic T3 questions for one-shot bounded development evaluation after configuration freeze
data_roles.official_dev_all_observed: 12 all-observed T3 questions; descriptive and underpowered; never used for selection

forbidden_inputs: official dev examples during model selection
all-observed confirmatory pairs during fitting or model selection

model_input_contract.candidate: evidence-topology-neutral-v1 serialization after synchronized alias relabeling
model_input_contract.question: provided as a separate encoder input in memory
model_input_contract.repair_target: four-by-four binary title-mention binding matrix after the same alias relabeling
model_input_contract.training_permutation: one deterministic epoch-dependent S4 permutation shared by both members of a pair
model_input_contract.validation_permutation: all 24 S4 permutations scored for each member and averaged before ranking
